milestone: Resident GELU, softcap, RoPE and argmax; exact histograms; Rust buffer ownership across distinct native libraries
changes: Complete the pre-existing uncommitted nonlinear CUDA work through native ABI and Rust canonical routes, preserving original input/layout/recipe identity
Pack validated public i16 lookup and absolute RoPE tables once in the common arena; no private intermediate download
Preserve nonnegative histogram counts, apply bias only in the original byte codec, reject duplicate or incomplete rows before seal
Fence argmax arithmetic before copying public token IDs, then fence the token copy before publication; retain original slack on device
Bind every Rust Buffer to its Runtime by Arc identity, including consumption, sealing and release across libraries with colliding numeric handles
Add a standalone sm_90 CUDA parity diagnostic for the first authorized H100 experiment; do not execute it on the development VM

coverage.canonical_routes: 546 selected rows: 60 GELU, 120 RoPE, one softcap and one argmax per O=0/150/300. Exact full output order compared with prepare_row on synthetic inputs/tables, with selected input row views; not full forward passes or real Gamma.
coverage.histograms: One full 150-row GELU histogram per context, all 65535 counts checked in order through fake-driver observation and resident byte scatter. Counts retain the CPU source encoding.
coverage.rejections: Six canonical identity/coverage cases, twelve ABI arithmetic/span/table/driver/copy cases, and two cross-library handle collision cases. Errors are terminal.
coverage.regressions: Resident embedding/matrix/RNE/affine/gate/gather, native D10/D12 range transcript and original MAC parity; reduced CPU streaming lookup/GKR/WHIR positive with ideal MACs.

integrated_positive.scope: O0 reduced, ideal MAC, CPU protocol; not native producer-to-protocol integration

coverage.hardware_prepared: c71_nonlinear_parity.cu: all 65535 lookup entries twice, exact counts, RoPE families 64/128 including omitted identity pairs, cross-warp argmax ties and six arithmetic rejections; compiled, not executed.

memory_and_traffic.limits: The 64 native descriptors still require histogram consolidation/release planning. Rust owner/metadata, CPU proof/PCS/Seed6 state, HBM context/shared/stack, full simultaneous buffers and all transfers remain to be counted together.

build.development: Initial invocation from repository root missed rust/.cargo/config.toml and built a second artifact hash in the same canonical target (4m27s). Corrected working directory used target-cpu=native (3m21s); final owner fix rebuilt only the target crate (3m22s). No cache deletion or alternate target directory.

clippy.command: cargo clippy --offline --locked -j 1 -p volta-pcs --features c71-seed6-reference --lib --tests -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious

cuda_static.provenance: Built before the code commit with unchanged final CUDA sources. SASS extraction first failed to locate nvdisasm; succeeded with the existing toolkit bin directory on PATH. Both artifacts preserved under the development raw directory.

failures.cause: Assertion vrows.next().is_none() in unchanged output.rs:532 after rejected tie decision. Borrowed correlations in unchanged linear::verify are not fully consumed on rejection. The fixture requires exhaustion even after an error; no change to the session's up-front reserve burn.
failures.disposition: Preserved, not suppressed or fixed in this port. No coverage claimed for the subsequent simulator case.

development_corrections: Removed the pre-existing unfinished histogram seal subtraction of 2^31: CPU sources store original counts and their byte emitter applies the bias.
Changed argmax to fence the arithmetic flag before enqueuing token D2H, avoiding a pending stack-buffer destination if the later copy fails.
Extended the buffer-owner check after identifying numeric handle collisions across distinct shared-library copies.
